label: India-only research additions
description: Indian (Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada first, then other Indian languages) film, TV and OTT titles in which a woman is hypnotized, mind-controlled or possessed. Hand-curated research pass of 30 Sep 2026, merged into the site's existing categories. Titles where the controlled character is a child or teen are excluded; entries are non-explicit.
